title: Table
description: Table: Represents a combination of table schema definition and data rows for atomic table creation and population operations.

Schema.description: The table schema definition including columns, indexes, and constraints. TableSchema: Represents the complete schema definition of a SQLite table including columns, indexes, and constraints.

Rows.description: The data rows to insert into the table. Each dictionary represents a row with column names as keys.

TableConfig.description: Configuration settings for table creation and data insertion operations. TableConfig: Configuration settings for SQLite table operations and schema management.

CreateTableIfNotExists.description: Whether to create the table if it doesn't exist before inserting data.

DropTableIfExists.description: Whether to drop and recreate the table if it already exists.

ValidateDataAgainstSchema.description: Whether to validate that all row data matches the schema before insertion.

AutoExpandSchema.description: Whether to automatically add missing columns to the schema based on data row keys.

DefaultDataType.description: Default data type to use for auto-expanded columns when data type cannot be inferred. SqliteDataType: Defines SQLite data types and storage classes for column definitions and type mapping.

MaxValidationRows.description: Maximum number of rows to validate against schema. Set to -1 to validate all rows.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
